architecture.mechanism: Coherence estimators quantify unbalanced voltage and current components that degrade machine efficiency and shorten service life.
architecture.intervention: Implement a fast discrete protection system using fifteen coherence coefficients calculated from instantaneous terminal measurements to identify and isolate hidden unbalance or shunt faults in the three-phase supply.
architecture.expected_effect: Accurate and swift detection of power quality disturbances and imbalances, preventing efficiency losses and thermal overloads during no-load running.
architecture.falsification_test: Introduce a controlled slight voltage unbalance at the motor terminals; if the thermal overload still trips, the mechanism is invalidated, as the coherence-based detection should have identified the cause of the heating.
